rationale: This mutation eliminates the -$18.3k cash deficit by extending Town Shop contract fulfillment through Day 30 to capture 2.0x-3.5x price premiums on terminal harvests, while upgrading shed management into a dual-mode system that monetizes uncommitted surplus at cyclical peaks (price >= 1.10x) behind shop fulfillment to prevent contract cannibalization. It accelerates early-game workforce scaling via a tiered 1.20x wage reserve buffer, decouples routine seed procurement from land acquisition while strictly bounding contiguous land expansion to 14-16 plots to eliminate walking transit overhead, and corrects the phantom 4-unit livestock feed reserve when holding zero animals. Finally, it optimizes farm execution with opportunity-based adjacent harvest chaining and pre-planting fertilization, culminating in an orderly harvest-and-liquidate transition on Days 29-30.
